description: This file contains Go source code implementing schema coercion logic for Kubernetes ObjectMeta and TypeMeta, including functions for coercing and validating object metadata based on schema definitions.

classes.name: coercer
classes.description: A struct used internally to perform schema coercion with configurable options.

methods.name: CoerceOptions
methods.description: A struct defining options for schema coercion, including whether to drop invalid fields and return unknown field paths.

methods.name: CoerceWithOptions
methods.description: Main function to coerce an object according to schema, with options to track unknown fields and handle invalid data.

methods.name: Coerce
methods.description: Convenience function to coerce an object without tracking unknown field paths.

methods.name: coerce (method of coercer)
methods.description: Performs recursive coercion of object fields based on schema, handling embedded resources, metadata, and nested properties.
